}}The '''apartment''' owned by [[Maria Latore]], located in the [[Saint Mark's]] district of [[Portland]], [[Liberty City (3D Universe)|Liberty City]], is a location in ''[[Grand Theft Auto: Liberty City Stories]]''.

==History==
By [[1998]], Maria moves into her apartment due to her strained relationship with her husband, [[Leone Crime Family]] [[Don]] [[Salvatore Leone]]. Throughout the first half of ''Liberty City Stories'', Toni frequently visits Maria's apartment, from which he is given missions by her.

The apartment also appears in ''[[Grand Theft Auto III]]'', set in [[2001]], but plays no role in the storyline and it is unknown if Maria still owns it.

The apartment also appears in the background during the ''[[Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas]]''' mission [[Saint Mark's Bistro]].
